title: Use AI to Research 10x Faster
description:
A faster research workflow using AI to gather, cross-check, and organize information without losing accuracy.

#AIResearch #Productivity #AITools

scenes.narration: Researching a topic used to mean twenty open browser tabs. AI can cut that down to a fraction of the time, if you use it the right way.

Start broad, not narrow. Ask an AI assistant to map out the main subtopics of your subject first, before you dive into any one of them. This gives you a structure to research into, instead of following one random thread and missing entire angles you didn't know existed.
Then go deep on each subtopic one at a time, asking follow-up questions like you're interviewing an expert.

Here's the part people skip: always ask for sources, and actually check a few of them. AI assistants can be confidently wrong, especially on niche or fast-changing topics, so treat its answers as a fast first draft to verify, not a finished fact.
Use AI to summarize long sources you've already verified, that's where it saves the most real time.

Finally, ask it to organize everything you've gathered into a structured outline at the end, not the beginning. That way the structure reflects what you actually found, instead of forcing your research into a structure you guessed at before you started.
Used this way, AI doesn't replace research, it removes the slow parts, reading everything cover to cover, and leaves you more time for the part that actually matters: judgment.
Try this on your next research task and see how much time it saves. Subscribe for more.
